guest_agent.probe_error: UTM got an error: The QEMU guest agent is not running or not installed on the guest. (-2700)

interpretation: The running UTM VM accelerates an aarch64 guest, while the pinned OSWorld Docker runtime and QCOW2 guest are x86-64. Architecture-specific ARM virtualization cannot supply x86 KVM acceleration to the nested OSWorld guest, so this VM would retain an emulated x86 path. Its configured 6 GiB RAM is also below the documented 8 GiB fallback recommendation.
